name: Mobile overnight PM for light/medium-duty service fleets (Cook/DuPage/Lake/Will)
summary: Equipped vans + hired technicians perform yard PM and DVIR-defect repairs overnight for 10-100-vehicle trade and route fleets; revenue = PM + repair pull-through per account; technicians hired per ~$22k/month of revenue.
evidence_notes: Buyer universe A floor: 528 private fleets with 10-100 USDOT power units in 8 counties (DC-S003); light vans unregistered.
PM price anchors A: Rockford POs $66 (oil+rotation), $380.50 for 2 PMs, $1,218 full service + repairs (DC-S019..S021); mobile priced at quality-shop parity (C, C4-S021).
Parts margin 28-30% at Rush (A, WS17-S021); tech wages C: Chicago auto tech median $55,320, diesel $65,680 (C4-S016).
Tech capacity: 1,200 billable h x $125 / (1 - 40% parts share) / 12 = ~$21k revenue/month per tech (E).
ARPC base 15 vehicles x (3.5 PM x $130/12 + 1.2x repairs) = $1,251/mo (E).
No dedicated sales rep: a $6k/mo rep adding ~1.2 accounts/mo lowered base y3 operating profit by ~$45k in testing; founder + lead tech sell.

drivers.arpc_monthly__source: 10/15/20 vehicles x 3-4 PMs/yr x $110/130/160 + 0.8/1.2/1.6x repair pull-through; PM anchored on Rockford POs (DC-S019, DC-S020)
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Initial baseline inspection + catch-up repairs; $1,218 single-unit full service+repairs (DC-S021)
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Ex-tech-labor: parts/fluids 45/40/35% of revenue at 28/30/35% margin (Rush parts GM 28-30%, A, WS17-S021) + 3-4% supplies/disposal
drivers.dso_days__source: Net-30 norm (C4 memo); slow payers assumed in cons

staff.notes: Lead tech hired month 3 (before first PM night); Chicago auto/diesel medians $55-66k (C4-S016) + premium for self-directed night work, x1.25 load
